description: The Bhāgavata Purāṇa (Śrīmad Bhāgavatam) is one of the eighteen Mahāpurāṇas, traditionally attributed to Vyāsa and narrated by Śuka to King Parīkṣit, as retold by Sūta to the sages at Naimiṣāraṇya. Twelve cantos (skandhas), 335 chapters, roughly 18,000 verses. Pilot scope: Canto 1, Chapter 1, verses 1–10.
